train_self_training_classifier: train a SelfTrainingClassifier with varying confidence thresholds on partially labeled data
evaluate_self_training_thresholds: evaluate SelfTrainingClassifier accuracy across different confidence thresholds using cross-validation
configure_svm_base_classifier: configure an SVC classifier with probability estimates as the base classifier for self-training
cross_validate_partially_labeled_data: cross-validate a partially labeled dataset using StratifiedKFold with -1 unlabeled markers
compute_accuracy_predictions: compute accuracy score between true labels and SelfTrainingClassifier predictions on test data
